localized atmosphere visibly moves after arrival and pauses offscreen at 1440px
direct, internal and refresh About arrivals stay nonblocking; Home retains its full loop
early keyboard settles the entrance without blocking content
early scroll settles the entrance without blocking content
reduced provides the complete static story
save-data provides the complete static story
hidden provides the complete static story
init-failure provides the complete static story
changing motion preferences during arrival releases the full composition immediately
no-JavaScript mobile story, native menu, portrait and invitation remain usable
story panels, names and principles reveal once without trapping native backscroll at 390px
story panels, names and principles reveal once without trapping native backscroll at 1440px

inline About prepaint fails open when all JavaScript bundles are delayed

portrait arrival leaves navigation pointer targets immediately usable at 1440px

portrait asset delayed leaves all three paragraphs and navigation readable
early resize and rapid internal navigation cannot leave stale arrival transforms
